events.description: Called with the ids now expanded each time a row opens or closes.
events.name: onExpandedChange

events.description: Called with a row's id when it is activated (pressed, or Enter on web).
events.name: onAction

events.description:
Loads the children of a row marked `hasChildren` the first time it is expanded. A spinner row shows while the
promise is pending and the tree keeps the rows it resolves to; a rejection closes the row so it can be tried again.
events.name: onLoadChildren

events.description:
Called when rows are dragged (or moved from the keyboard) to a new place: before or after a row, or inside it.
Given, rows can be dragged on web; the tree does not move them itself, so update `items` (`moveTreeNodes` does
it). Native has no dragging and ignores it.
events.name: onMove

events.description: Called with the ids now selected each time the selection changes, in the order the items are in.
events.name: onSelectionChange

props.description: The top-level rows, in order.
props.name: items

props.description: The accessible name of the tree, for example "Chart of accounts".
props.name: label

props.description: The ids of the expanded rows, for a controlled tree; pair it with `onExpandedChange`.
props.name: expandedKeys

props.description: The ids expanded at the start, for an uncontrolled tree.
props.name: defaultExpandedKeys

props.description:
True with `selectionMode="multiple"`: checking a row checks every row under it, a row is checked once all its
rows are, and a row with only some of its rows checked shows a dash. The selection holds every checked id.
props.name: isSelectionPropagated

props.description: What a press or Space does: nothing, select one item, or toggle several. Defaults to `none`.
props.name: selectionMode

props.description: The ids of the selected items, for a controlled collection; pair it with `onSelectionChange`.
props.name: selectedKeys

props.description: The ids selected at the start, for an uncontrolled collection.
props.name: defaultSelectedKeys

props.description: Classes added to the tree's root.
props.name: className

props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.
props.name: aria-describedby

props.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed, extended description for the
object.
props.name: aria-details

props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.
props.name: aria-labelledby

props.description: Whether to auto focus the gridlist or an option.
props.name: autoFocus

props.description: Values that should invalidate the item cache when using dynamic collections.
props.name: dependencies

props.description: Whether `disabledKeys` applies to all interactions, or only selection.
props.name: disabledBehavior

props.description: Whether the collection allows empty selection.
props.name: disallowEmptySelection

props.description:
The drag and drop hooks returned by `useDragAndDrop` used to enable drag and drop behavior for
the Tree.
props.name: dragAndDropHooks

props.description:
Whether pressing the escape key should clear selection in the grid list or not.

Most experiences should not modify this option as it eliminates a keyboard user's ability to
easily clear selection. Only use if the escape key is being handled externally or should not
trigger selection clearing contextually.
props.name: escapeKeyBehavior

props.description:
The element's unique identifier. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/id).
props.name: id

props.description:
Whether keyboard navigation to focusable elements within grid list items is
via the left/right arrow keys or the tab key.
props.name: keyboardNavigationBehavior

props.description:
Overrides the default DOM element with a custom render function.
This allows rendering existing components with built-in styles and behaviors
such as router links, animation libraries, and pre-styled components.

Requirements:

- You must render the expected element type (e.g. if `<button>` is expected, you cannot render an
  `<a>`).
- Only a single root DOM element can be rendered (no fragments).
- You must pass through props and ref to the underlying DOM element, merging with your own prop
  as appropriate.
props.name: render

props.description: Provides content to display when there are no items in the list.
props.name: renderEmptyState

props.description: How multiple selection should behave in the tree.
props.name: selectionBehavior

props.description: Whether selection should occur on press up instead of press down.
props.name: shouldSelectOnPressUp

props.description:
A slot name for the component. Slots allow the component to receive props from a parent
component. An explicit `null` value indicates that the local props completely override all
props received from a parent.
props.name: slot

props.description:
The inline [style](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/style) for the
element. A function may be provided to compute the style based on component state.
props.name: style
